Alex / Priya — great to meet you both today. Thanks for the time and for walking through FinPath's main goals around customer-facingAssist and the scale concerns you mentioned (heavy inference during monthly closes).

Quick recap from our side:
- Primary goals: reduce latency for 1K+ concurrent requests, lower per-token costs during peak windows, and ensure auditability for regulated data.
- Constraints: procurement timeline ~6–8 weeks; security needs SOC 2 / VPC options; platform prefers model pinning and predictable throughput.

Next step: we'd like to run a 45–60 minute demo + technical deep dive tailored to your engineers where Monica (SE) can show our batching/quantization profiles and Neha (security) can walk through SOC2 and VPC controls. Can you share 2–3 times next week that work?

I can also send a calendar poll: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/finpath-demo

Looping Monica (SE) to propose times and note she'll prepare an architecture view. Once you confirm timing, I'll loop in Neha (security) and Priyom (procurement) so we can address those threads live.

Thanks,
Marissa
